image_description: A close-up view of a bakery display window featuring rows of round, flour-dusted bread loaves on an upper shelf. Below the glass, inside the shop, staff members in white uniforms and aprons are visible working behind counters filled with various pastries and baked goods. The scene is illuminated by warm interior lighting, creating reflections on the glass.

The human figures in the background have indistinct features and slightly melted anatomy, particularly around the hands and arms interacting with the counter.
Minor inconsistencies in the reflection lines on the glass and the straightness of the shelf edges in the background.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'melting' of the background staff figures. While they are out of focus, AI often fails to render even blurred humans correctly (e.g., extra limbs or fused bodies). Also, scrutinize the top row of bread: do they look like distinct physical objects, or do they blend into each other? Check if the 'flour' looks like powder or just white paint patches.
